text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A massive barrage of size 10 fireworks! I 
can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks festival... was it? The one 
you said you were going to tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's a pretty well-known tournament, 
and I've always wanted to see it in person 
someday!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks, huh. You always did love big 
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it feel great when things kick off 
with a big bang? What do you think, Air 
Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I had to choose, I prefer things with 
an atmospheric charm, like sparklers or 
handheld fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, having it gently glowing right in 
your hands isn't bad at all. How about 
you, Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I like snake fireworks. The way they 
silently do their best is rather adorable, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oho...! People's tastes are surprisingly 
divided. Though I suppose that's part of 
the charm of fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still, that worked out quite well then.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't wait, so I bought the whole 
complete set. Let's all play together 
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The fireworks festival is tomorrow, isn't 
it? Just how much do you love them...
